name: duo-watchdog
description: Watches your own GitLab Credits (GitLab Duo) for each of your GitLab accounts: used, left, the month-end forecast, usage by day and by feature, a year of statistics, with alerts before you hit your limit.

commands.title: Set GitLab Token (now Add or Replace a Token)

duoWatchdog.gitlabUrl.markdownDescription:
The GitLab a new token is for, unless you type another: `https://gitlab.com` or the address of your self-managed GitLab. Each account keeps its own.

Tokens are not settings: run **Duo Watchdog: Add or Replace a Token** (they are kept in VS Code's secret storage), and **Duo Watchdog: Accounts** to see and manage them.

duoWatchdog.groupPath.markdownDescription: Before accounts: the path of the top-level group that owns the Duo subscription. Read once, to set up the first account from the token saved before.
duoWatchdog.groupPath.markdownDeprecationMessage: Each account has its own group path now: run **Duo Watchdog: Accounts** and use *Set Group Path*, or **Duo Watchdog: Find My Group**. This setting was read once, to set up the first account.
duoWatchdog.groupPath.deprecationMessage: Each account has its own group path now: run Duo Watchdog: Accounts and use Set Group Path, or Duo Watchdog: Find My Group. This setting was read once, to set up the first account.

duoWatchdog.limit.markdownDescription: Before accounts: your limit in credits. Read once, to set up the first account from the token saved before.
duoWatchdog.limit.markdownDeprecationMessage: Each account has its own limit now: run **Duo Watchdog: Accounts** and use *Set Limit*. This setting was read once, to set up the first account.
duoWatchdog.limit.deprecationMessage: Each account has its own limit now: run Duo Watchdog: Accounts and use Set Limit. This setting was read once, to set up the first account.

duoWatchdog.alertPercents.markdownDescription: Percents of each account's limit to be alerted at, comma-separated, e.g. `50, 80, 95`. Each alert shows once per billing period and account.

duoWatchdog.forecastAlert.description: Alert when the month-end forecast passes the limit.

duoWatchdog.refreshMinutes.markdownDescription: How often to read the credits of every account, in minutes. GitLab's usage data can lag a few minutes behind actual use.
